statuses.working: Every declared implementation and document exists, and an exact-commit receipt records a successful real interaction plus its evidence.
statuses.failed: A declared implementation or document is missing, a real interaction failed, or its receipt is malformed or belongs to another commit.
statuses.unrun: Declarations exist but the real interaction has not produced an exact-commit receipt.
statuses.not-applicable: A receipt names the exact technical boundary and the closest shipped equivalent. This is never inferred automatically.

knownExternalLimitations.reason: The gh CLI has no supported route for uploading the repository social-preview setting. The committed asset cannot prove that setting was changed.
